verdict.rationale: Okta documents SCIM-based user provisioning integrations, with a defined user/group schema and CRUD operations on those resources, which covers the downstream push of user changes into app assignments. Nothing in the evidence shows an HRIS acting as the authoritative source, inbound HR-driven mastering, or automated joiner/mover/leaver handling. missing for 10: HRIS-as-source-of-truth (HR-driven inbound provisioning) documentation, explicit joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle automation, automatic group/app assignment rules driven by HR attributes, independent or hands-on corroboration
